title: Catalog release visuals and quickstart screenshots for onboarding + deprecation flows
creator: Ava Morgan
description: Create a focused bundle of design assets for the upcoming model-catalog release notes and the onboarding quickstart. The bundle must include high-fidelity screenshots for: the new-model launch card, the deprecation warning flow, price-tier toggles, and the quickstart 'first-run' overlay. Assets should be optimized for release notes (1200px wide hero), product docs (800px inline), and Console in-app previews (1280x720 and 360x800 for mobile). Deliverables should be ready for localization and accessible alt text. Coordinate with PM for copy and Eng for exact component states.
tasks: Audit current catalog visuals and collect last-release screenshot sources (DES-4821, DES-9153 used as reference)
Design hero screenshots: new model card (desktop 1200x675), deprecation modal + inline ribbon (desktop and mobile variants)
Create quickstart overlay screenshots showing 'first-run' model selection and price toggle states (A/B pricing CTA variants)
Export annotated PNGs for docs and SVGs for in-product use; include 2x exports for retina
Write alt text and short caption text for each screenshot; add localization keys placeholder
Hand off Figma file + export pack in Drive and link to GitHub PR with release notes images
Run accessibility contrast check and include WCAG notes in handoff
assets: hero-new-model-desktop-1200x675.png - new model launch card with 'Verified' badge and price tier callout
hero-new-model-mobile-360x800.png - stacked card, primary CTA visible
deprecation-ribbon-inline-800x200.png - inline catalog row with subtle orange ribbon 'Deprecated'
deprecation-modal-desktop-980x600.png - modal explaining why model is deprecated and recommended replacements
quickstart-overlay-step1-1280x720.png - onboarding step selecting model and region
quickstart-overlay-pricing-toggles-B-1280x720.png - pricing toggle variant B (commit vs burst view)
thumbnail-catalog-list-400x200.png - catalog list compact view with new model highlight
export-pack/readme.txt - instructions for engineers: filenames, recommended CDN paths, alt text keys
acceptance_criteria: All hero screenshots exported at required sizes (1200px, 800px, 1280x720, 360x800) and included in Drive export pack
Figma file contains named frames and an 'exports' page; engineering can reproduce images without design questions
Alt text and short captions provided for each asset and saved as 'alt_keys' in the export-pack/readme.txt
Localization placeholders present (en-US copy + i18n keys) and PM has approved the copy in links below
Accessibility checks passed: contrast ratios documented; any failing elements are annotated with remediation steps
Release note author can plug hero images into Markdown with provided captions and image sizes
